purpose: Held-out workflow scenarios for the read-only workflow-feedback shadow scorer. These scenarios test whether manually reviewed Experience Object v0 fixtures surface the right reusable lesson before any runtime, retrieval, or tool-routing influence.

scenario_cases.scenario: A future Agent-Bridge session finds that interactive Claude Code accepts no follow-up agent_send_input after reconnect because the child process is blocked on a chrome/browser first-run prompt.
scenario_cases.review_intent: The scorer should rank the interactive runtime dogfood and --no-chrome recovery experience above generic workflow-feedback process lessons.

scenario_cases.scenario: A future planning session asks whether workflow-feedback lessons should immediately change retrieval ranking or tool routing, or remain report-first with shadow scoring and owner gates.
scenario_cases.review_intent: The scorer should rank the research-to-report-to-CLI experience above the agent runtime repair experience.
